from weather.summary import daily_summary, load_rows


def test_load_rows_skips_comment_lines(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "export.csv"
    path.write_text("# logger v2\ndate,temp_c,rain_mm,wind_kph\n2024-06-01,20.0,1.0,5.0\n")
    assert load_rows(str(path))[0]["temp_c"] == 20.0


def test_load_rows_sorted():
    rows = load_rows("data/station_a.csv")
    assert [row["day"].day for row in rows] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]


def test_summary_station_a():
    summary = daily_summary(load_rows("data/station_a.csv"))
    assert summary["temp_min"] == 19.8
    assert summary["temp_max"] == 26.0
    assert summary["temp_mean"] == 23.0
    assert summary["rain_total"] == 7.6
